messages:
alex: Heads-up — CI promo blocked on linux wheel build for legacy FFI bindings. Failing during link stage with 'undefined symbol: PyInit_ffi'.
jen: ugh. which job? the manylinux2014 wheel one?
alex: yes, job: build-wheels/manylinux-ffi. saw on runner-12. full snippet: `ld: undefined symbol: PyInit_ffi` right after building the .so.
priya: could be a pybind11 ABI mismatch or the new gcc toolchain change in the base image. did the baseimage bump land in main?
dan: it did last night (glibc/toolchain patch). I can try reproducing locally with the same image.
release-bot: Promotion paused — artifact missing: //bindings:ffi-wheel (manylinux) — reason: build_failure. See CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood.example/build/12345
ops: change window reminder — we have a 1h maintenance window starting in 40m if we need to ship a hotfix.
jen: short-term unblock options: 1) pin previous working wheel from s3; 2) revert baseimage bump; 3) attempt rebuild with older toolchain.
alex: preference is pin wheel in the deploy manifest and promote so we don't revert infra. less blast radius.
priya: agree. we should also record a follow-up task to fix the build later (FFI ABI compatibility).
dan: I can upload the last-good wheel to staging. command I used: `gsutil cp gs://artifacts/wheels/ffi-1.2.3-manylinux.whl gs://staging/wheels/` then update manifest.
alex: ping @jen for manifest change. we need to pin to `ffi==1.2.3` in release-manifest.yaml and run a manual canary promote.
jen: on it. patch: `release-manifest.yaml: bindings/ffi: version: "1.2.3"  # pinned to last-good wheel`
jen: starting manual promote job now.
release-bot: Manual promote requested by jen — run-id 8992. Will canary against eu-west-1 small fleet.
ops: if canary green, we can cut release within the change window. otherwise rollback plan = revert manifest and queue full CI rebuild.
priya: also adding a note to release notes: "Temporary pin: legacy ffi wheel pinned to 1.2.3 due to linux manylinux build failures; will investigate ABI/toolchain compatibility."
dan: canary logs so far: installs wheel, smoke tests ok for chat and embeddings, failing stress test still pending.
alex: thanks. if canary passes, we should unfreeze the release notes and publish the patch release. alex: also create a GH issue to track the underlying build fix (label: infra/ffi).
jen: canary completed — green ✅. promote job reports success.
release-bot: Promotion complete — version pinned and released to production (hotfix/2026-03-21-ffi-pin).
ops: shipped. I'll extend observability retention for the next 72h to watch for regressions.
priya: added GH issue with logs and reproducer steps. assigning to dan.
dan: will reproduce and try building with the older toolchain; if successful we'll add a CI variant to ensure future toolchain bumps don't break ABI.
alex: cool. for release notes: "Hotfix: pinned legacy FFI wheel to 1.2.3 to unblock release after manylinux build linker failure. Follow-up: investigate toolchain/pybind11 ABI mismatch; revert pin once fixed." keep it short.
jen: copied notes into changelog and published release candidate. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks everyone — closing thread.
